headline: Equity mutual funds and ETFs show different flow directions; broad institutional exit is not established

measurements.derivation: combined equity flow minus equity ETF net issuance

comparisons.interpretation: Combined equity fund flows became more negative week over week.
Estimated combined bond fund inflows increased week over week.

counterevidence: Equity ETFs recorded positive net issuance even as the combined equity category recorded outflows. ETF issuance and mutual fund redemptions should not be collapsed into an unqualified institutional selling claim.

unresolved_question: Why SPY remains supported cannot be determined from weekly fund flows alone; requires intraday price, sector contribution, ETF creation/redemption and dealer hedge data.
